title: Polypiler vector file
description: A tests/fixtures/**/*.vectors.json file: the expected values of a corpus fixture and where they came from (PRD 11.2). 'polypiler-tooling integrity check' additionally requires that a reference-run source is a key of tooling/toolchains.lock, an upstream-embedded source is a file of tooling/corpus/corpus.lock.json, and generatedBy does not name Polypiler.

fixture.description: The corpus fixture ID the vectors belong to.

exactness.description: How outputs are compared (docs/adr/0005-floating-point-tolerance.md); exact when absent. The verification framework (Polypiler.Core.Verification/Oracles) reads and checks it.

export.description: The function a language runner calls. Present exactly when 'signature' is; both are absent in a whole-program byte-stream file.

expectedTrap.description: The trap class the call ends in, in place of an output image; only with a signature's file in practice, never together with 'expected'.

signature.description: The typed call signature: the image type (the notation of Polypiler.Core.Verification/Images/ImageType) and mode of every parameter, and the result type. Every input decodes completely as the input image (the 'in' and 'inout' arguments in order), every expected value as the output image (the result, then the 'inout' and 'out' values after the call).

source.description: published: the document; reference-run: a key of tooling/toolchains.lock; upstream-embedded: owner/repo@<commit>:<path>.

detail.description: The section, the exact command, or the line.

generatedBy.description: The tool that wrote the values, or 'hand'; never Polypiler.
